answer: A concrete defense is a per-epoch work summit: to earn voting voice, an identity must solve one unique compute task whose parameters derive from its public key plus the epoch seed, so no proof can be reused across accounts. A farm splitting one key across an island of clones emits identical intermediate hashes, and the cluster detector voids every account in that island at once. Rewards vest at the epoch's nadir, long after the work is done, so a farm's capital sits locked while honest agents have already moved on. Cloning pays the full summit climb per alias; honesty climbs once.
